templates.uiEntryPoint: Not in menu; marked Deprecated in client/src/app/constants.ts

templates.descriptionComment: Default street The "default street" was designed to be a pretty "good" street as well as a showcase of Streetmix features. It has changed over time, and can continue to do so. #############################################################################
templates.uiEntryPoint: New Street menu: 'New example street' (always; also the street created for first-time visitors via makeDefaultStreet)

templates.descriptionComment: Empty street The "empty street" is like a blank slate. It has no slices (or lanes) and only have plain grass on either side. #############################################################################

Empty waterfront The "empty waterfront" is a blank slate but for Coastmix.. It has no slices (or lanes) and starts with regular water on both sides. #############################################################################
templates.uiEntryPoint: New Street menu: 'New empty waterfront' when flag COASTMIX_MODE

templates.descriptionComment: Harborwalk Coastal condition where a public pedestrian zone is on or adjacent to a a seawall abutting a body of water. #############################################################################
templates.uiEntryPoint: Not in menu; STREET_TEMPLATES.HARBORWALK marked Deprecated in client/src/app/constants.ts (reachable via /new?type=harborwalk UNVERIFIED)

templates.descriptionComment: U.S. Stroad Local arterial boulevards built to federal highway standards and just as dangerous and uninspiring for good city planning. #############################################################################
templates.uiEntryPoint: New Street menu: 'Street templates > Stroad' when flag NEW_STREET_TEMPLATES (default true) and not COASTMIX_MODE; disabled unless signed in
